extracted.intended_audience: Comedy fans and festival attendees (locals and visitors planning to attend Moontower Comedy Festival in Austin)
extracted.subtask_description: Information and practical guidance for attending the Moontower Comedy Festival (badges, venues, lineup, and year‑round events) in Austin. Useful for prospective attendees choosing badges, planning nights, and tracking lineup announcements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Club Badge (badge type)
rubrics_metrics.description: "The Club Badge gains you access to all club venues as well as the opportunity to purchase tickets for headlining shows before anyone else."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grants entry to club venues and early opportunity to buy headlining-show tickets; good for attendees who want broad club access plus a chance at headliner tickets (but does not promise skip-the-line or guaranteed headliner seats).

rubrics_metrics.name: Club Premium Badge (badge type)
rubrics_metrics.description: "The Club Premium Badge gets you skip-the-line entry to all club venues and early access to purchase headlining tickets."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes skip-the-line at club venues plus early purchasing rights for headlining shows; positioned as an upgrade over the Club Badge for faster entry and convenience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full Moon Badge (badge type)
rubrics_metrics.description: "The Full Moon Badge includes skip-the-line entry to all club shows and guaranteed seats at 10 headlining shows of your choosing."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highest-tier badge: combines skip-the-line club access with guaranteed seating at a chosen set of headlining shows (ten). Best for attendees who want certainty of seeing headliners without needing to individually buy seats later.

rubrics_metrics.name: Daily wristband (single-night access)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Only free one night of the festival? Purchase a daily wristband for access to a full night of shows and parties."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Single-night wristband option for attendees who want one evening of shows/parties rather than a multi-day badge; useful for visitors or locals with limited availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lineup composition and variety
rubrics_metrics.description: "From stand-up acts to podcast tapings, there are plenty of opportunities to see your favorite comedians and be introduced to some new ones. The 2026 festival lineup featured headlining comics including Marc Maron, Leslie Jones, Jeff Arcuri, Kathy Griffin, Vir Das, Brad Williams, René Vaca, Shxts N Gigs and Cristela Alonzo."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Festival programming mixes national headliners with varied formats (stand-up, podcast tapings). Past lineups are given as examples; specific year lineups (e.g., 2027) are announced closer to the event—check the official page for updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venue distribution and headliner venues
rubrics_metrics.description: "The festival is held at various venues around Downtown Austin, with headliners performing at the historic Paramount Theater, Stateside at the Paramount, Moody Center and more."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes between club venues (where badge club access applies) and larger historic/theater venues that host headliners; attendees should note that headlining shows may be at different, larger venues than club shows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Festival duration and timing
rubrics_metrics.description: "The ... Moontower Comedy Festival is set to return to Austin in April 2027. Get ready to laugh along with your favorite comedians during the more than week-long festivities!"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Festival runs for more than a week in April; lineup and exact dates are announced closer to the event—plan travel/tickets accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Staying informed / official information source
rubrics_metrics.description: "The 2027 lineup will be announced closer to the event date. To stay up-to-date on the latest announcements, visit austintheatre.org/moontower-comedy."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the official Moontower/Austin Theatre site for authoritative lineup, badge sales, and scheduling updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Year-round programming and additional events
rubrics_metrics.description: "Paramount Theatre and Moontower Comedy work hard to keep Austin laughing all year long. Find additional events, comedy sets, live podcast tapings at the Paramount's website."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond the flagship festival, related comedy events and live tapings occur year-round; attendees interested in more comedy programming should consult the Paramount Theatre listings.
